title: Name the tax rate
prompt: The 0.2 here is a 20% tax. Name it `TAX_RATE` so the next reader does not have to guess.
starter:
func solve(price) -> float:
	return price + price * 0.2
hints: Constants are usually CAPITALS with underscores.
The value can be a decimal.

docs.name: const NAME = value
docs.what: Declares a named value that never changes. Written in CAPITALS by convention.
